guide.the_skill_teaches_delegation_norma: The Skill teaches delegation, Norma CLI routes work, Agent Hook reports lifecycle events, and authorization keeps access scoped to this device.
guide.install_orchestration_for_the_agen: Install orchestration for the agents you use. Norma configures the Skill, CLI, Agent Hook, and authorization together.
guide.shortcut_cheat_sheet_summary: Switch workspaces and projects, create cards, and dispatch ideas. Every key can be changed in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.
guide.cheat_new_agents: Claude · Codex · Cursor · OpenCode · Grok · Kimi · Pi · Hermes
guide.cheat_assign_typed: New agent of a type and send (digits as ⌘2…9)
guide.cheat_idea_reorder: Move idea up / down in the bar
guide.demo.voice-command.title: Talk to Norma, coordinate your agents
guide.demo.voice-command.label: Voice Interaction
guide.demo.voice-command.summary: Give Norma a spoken instruction, assign work to multiple agents, and follow their progress in the same workspace.
guide.demo.agent-collaboration.title: Agents delegate tasks to each other
guide.demo.agent-collaboration.label: Agent Collaboration
guide.demo.agent-collaboration.summary: Ask one agent to delegate focused tasks. Other agents work in parallel and return their results to the delegator.
guide.demo.live-node-shortcuts.title: Create agent cards in seconds
guide.demo.live-node-shortcuts.label: Quick Agent Cards
guide.demo.live-node-shortcuts.summary: Type / in the command bar to create an agent card. Give each card its own task and watch the agents work side by side.
guide.demo.layout-command-m.title: Expand a card with ⌘M
guide.demo.layout-command-m.label: Expand with ⌘M
guide.demo.layout-command-m.summary: Select a card and press ⌘M to expand it. Press ⌘M again to return to the overview while the other cards keep running.
guide.demo.chief-of-staff.title: Keep progress in view with the Chief of Staff
guide.demo.chief-of-staff.label: Chief of Staff
guide.demo.chief-of-staff.summary: Follow agent activity and task progress with Norma’s Chief of Staff, and review what needs your attention before deciding what comes next.
guide.demo.right-drawer.title: Files and webpages beside your agents
guide.demo.right-drawer.label: Right Drawer
guide.demo.right-drawer.summary: Open documents and live web previews in the right drawer while keeping your agents in view.
guide.demo.switch-workspaces.title: Move between projects and workspaces
guide.demo.switch-workspaces.label: Switch Projects & Spaces
guide.demo.switch-workspaces.summary: Use ⌘←/→ to switch projects, ⇧⌘←/→ to switch workspaces, or ⇧⌘↑ to open the workspace switcher.
guide.demo.workspace-home.title: Create and find your workspaces
guide.demo.workspace-home.label: Workspace Home
guide.demo.workspace-home.summary: Create a workspace from the home screen, return with ⇧⌘K, and search by name to find the work you want to continue.
guide.demo.slash-commands.title: Discover commands from one input
guide.demo.slash-commands.label: Slash Commands
guide.demo.slash-commands.summary: Type / to browse commands, create agents and terminals, or change themes from the command bar. Use /help to reopen this guide.
